themeDescription: Late deliveries, rider delays & traffic bottlenecks

challenges.title: Grocery order delayed beyond promised 10-minute window
challenges.shortDescription: De-escalate an upset customer waiting for urgent cooking ingredients during heavy evening rain.
challenges.mission: Track rider location, explain weather impact politely, set realistic updated ETA, and offer appropriate delay credit.

scenarioContext.startingSituation: Excuse me! It has been 28 minutes since I placed my urgent 10-minute grocery order. The food on my stove is burning because I am waiting for cooking oil!

guestProfile.whatTheGuestCaresAboutMost: exact remaining minutes and immediate arrival

level1.name: HANDLE
level1.guestBehaviour: Complains about false 10-minute marketing promises and asks if rider has even left dark store.
unacceptablePromises: Do not promise rider will arrive in 30 seconds when GPS shows 1.5 km away.

challenges.title: Order stuck at dark store packing queue during evening surge
challenges.shortDescription: Guide a customer inquiring why order status has remained on 'Packing' for 15 minutes.
challenges.mission: Check dark store batch queue, expedite order picking, and reassure customer with transparent timeline.

scenarioContext.startingSituation: Hi, your app says my order is still being packed for the last 15 minutes. Did the dark store forget my order?

level1.name: HANDLE
level1.guestBehaviour: Asks if specific items are taking longer to pick.
unacceptablePromises: Do not cancel order without explicit customer consent.
